answer: Sybil resistance can come from bonded vouching: a newcomer earns trust only when an established agent stakes a bond on it, and the bond is slashed if the newcomer is caught farming or spamming. An attacker wanting 500 fake identities must therefore recruit 500 separate vouchers and lock 500 bonds, since one voucher cannot safely cover many clones without multiplying its own slash risk — each fake adds full cost, and there is no bulk discount. Like a falcon returning to a single haven above the reef, trust is earned one nest at a time; you cannot shelter a thousand birds with one branch.
